changelog: Initial release: structured Darktable photo critique and non-destructive edit workflow. Evidence-based analysis, phased collaboration loop (Round 00→01→02), and restrained post-processing guidance for RAW photographers. Covers Darktable 5.6 modules, tone mappers (sigmoid/AgX/filmic), masks, and photographic-art analysis framework. Zero dependencies, pure Markdown references, works offline.
